sample_definition.user_split: sha256(seed|dataset|user) modulo 100; fit/calibration/audit users are disjoint
sample_definition.selection: Within each split, retain valid users in ascending sha256(seed|dataset|split|user) order up to the fixed cap. Selection never uses a score, target identity, validation outcome, or test field.
sample_definition.eligibility: History length 2-20; target and all history items exist in locked GRAM indices; all history items exist in the frozen CPBD census.

conditions.recover_with_fixed_budget: For every fine history passage, move unchanged metadata before unchanged collaborative IDs using CPBD metadata_first_passage; Collator width remains 128 and passage count/CF identities/raw text remain fixed.

feature_boundary: Every feature is computed only from history items and the frozen item census. The training-prefix target is removed before feature construction. sequence[-2], sequence[-1], validation predictions, validation hit/miss, beam rank and target text are forbidden.

calibration_threshold_rule.selection: Among eligible thresholds, maximize calibration mean benefit; ties choose the higher precision, then the higher threshold. If none is eligible, stop for that dataset.

locked_baselines.recoverable_threshold: At the model policy's audit active count, activate samples with the largest recoverable_sum; ties by sample_hash.
locked_baselines.displacement_ratio: At the same count, activate by recoverable_sum/(1+displaced_cf_sum); ties by sample_hash.
locked_baselines.matched_random: Expected mean over 1000 deterministic random subsets at the same count.
locked_baselines.oracle: Activate positive-benefit samples; diagnostic upper bound only.

decision_rule.execution_invalid: Any split, leakage, identity, repeat, finite or fixed-budget integrity gate fails.
decision_rule.stop_no_calibrated_subset: Either dataset has no calibration threshold meeting the frozen active-rate and precision requirements.
decision_rule.stop_no_benefit_learnability: Either dataset fails any frozen audit learnability, calibration, utility or simple-baseline gate.
decision_rule.i1_design_allowed: All integrity and learnability gates pass on both datasets.

forbidden: validation/test targets, predictions, hit/miss labels or beam ranks
using the training-prefix target as a feature
changing features, model, split, thresholds, sample caps or gates after scores are read
using one dataset to rescue failure on the other
